status: locked during historical option-tail backfill and before first direction execution
target: same-day TWII cash close versus prior completed cash close
decision_time: after completed TX and TXO night sessions and before TWII cash open
hypothesis: TXO night tail pricing adds cash-close direction beyond TX night price and lagged cash state.

data_policy.expiry_selection: most actively traded valid contract using completed-session volume
data_policy.atm_rule: strike minimizing absolute call-put settlement/close premium difference
data_policy.normalization: past-only rolling statistics or training-only statistics

variants.night_control: night spread/return/range/volume plus lagged cash returns and volatility
variants.night_plus_option_tail: control plus 1%/2% symmetric tail skew, OTM volume ratio, skew changes and two low-degree interactions

strong_baselines: night spread sign on identical selected dates
night return sign on identical selected dates
night control on common selected dates
amendment_policy: Any later code, feature, hyperparameter or gate change creates a new experiment id and cannot alter v1 conclusions.
